en.s: The Battle of Ctesiphon took place on 29 May 363 between the armies of Roman Emperor Julian and an army of the Sasanian Empire (during Shapur II's reign) outside the walls of the Persian capital Ctesiphon. The battle resulted in a Roman victory, but eventually the Roman forces found themselves unable to continue their campaign as they were too far from their supply lines.

zh.s: 363年5月29日，罗马皇帝尤利安的军队与萨珊帝国沙普尔二世统治时期的军队在波斯首都泰西封城外交战。罗马军获胜，但最终因远离补给线而无法继续战役。

en.t: A catastrophic earthquake hits Antioch, killing several thousands including patriarch Euphrasius
en.s: The 526 Antioch earthquake struck Syria and, in particular, the city of Antioch in the Byzantine Empire. It occurred some time in late May 526, probably between 20 and 29 May, during mid-morning, killing approximately 250,000 people. This was in the seventh year of the reign of the Byzantine emperor Justin I and occurred under the consulship of Olybrius.

zh.t: 安条克发生毁灭性地震，数千人遇难，包括牧首欧弗拉修斯
zh.s: 526年安条克地震袭击了叙利亚，尤其是拜占庭帝国的安条克城。地震发生于526年5月下旬，可能在5月20日至29日之间的上午，造成约250,000人死亡。当时正值拜占庭皇帝查士丁一世在位第七年，奥利布里乌斯担任执政官。

en.s: The Battle of Uclés was fought on 29 May 1108 near Uclés just south of the river Tagus between the Christian forces of Castile and León under Alfonso VI and the forces of the Muslim Almoravids under Tamim ibn-Yusuf. The battle was a disaster for the Christians and many of the high nobility of León, including seven counts, died in the fray or were beheaded afterwards, while the heir-apparent, Sancho Alfónsez, was murdered by villagers while trying to flee. Despite this, the Almoravids could not capitalise on their success in the open field by taking Toledo.

zh.s: 1108年5月29日，卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂的基督教军队与穆拉比特王朝军队在塔霍河以南、乌克莱斯附近交战。阿方索六世率领基督教军队，穆拉比特王朝军队则由塔米姆·伊本·优素福统率。基督教一方惨败，莱昂的许多贵族，包括七名伯爵，在战斗中阵亡或随后被斩首；王位继承人桑乔·阿方索斯在逃跑时被村民杀死。尽管取得胜利，穆拉比特王朝仍未能乘势在野战中攻取托莱多。

en.s: In the Battle of Yibneh (Yibna) in 1123, a Crusader force led by Eustace Grenier crushed a Fatimid army from Egypt sent by vizier Al-Ma'mun between Ascalon and Jaffa.

zh.s: 1123年，欧斯塔斯·格雷尼耶率领的十字军在伊卜纳战役中击溃了法蒂玛王朝从埃及派出的军队。那支军队由维齐尔马蒙派遣，行军路线位于阿斯卡隆和雅法之间。

en.s: The Battle of Monte Porzio (also called the Battle of Tusculum) was fought on 29 May 1167 between the Holy Roman Empire and the Commune of Rome. The communal Roman army, which one historian has called the "greatest army which Rome had sent into the field in centuries", was defeated by the forces of the Emperor Frederick Barbarossa and his local allies, the Counts of Tusculum and the ruler of Albano. Comparing its effect on the city of Rome, one historian has been called Monte Porzio the "Cannae of the Middle Ages".

zh.s: 1167年5月29日，神圣罗马帝国与罗马公社在蒙特波尔齐奥交战，这场战役也称图斯库卢姆战役。罗马公社军队被神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨及其当地盟友击败；盟友包括图斯库卢姆伯爵和阿尔巴诺统治者。一位历史学家称，罗马数百年来派上战场的军队中，这支公社军队规模最大；另一位历史学家将战役对罗马城的影响比作“中世纪的坎尼战役”。

en.s: The Battle of Legnano was fought on May 29, 1176, between the forces of the Holy Roman Empire, led by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, and the Lombard League. The Imperial army suffered a major defeat.

zh.s: 1176年5月29日，神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨率领的军队与伦巴第联盟在莱尼亚诺交战。帝国军遭到重大失败。

en.s: In the siege of Kaifeng from 1232 to 1233, the Mongol Empire captured Kaifeng, the capital of the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty. The Mongol Empire and the Jin dynasty had been at war for nearly two decades, beginning in 1211 after the Jin dynasty refused the Mongol offer to submit as a vassal. Ögedei Khan sent two armies to besiege Kaifeng, one led by himself, and the other by his brother Tolui.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1232年至1233年的开封围城战中，蒙古帝国攻占了女真族建立的金朝首都开封。蒙古帝国与金朝此前已交战近20年，战争始于1211年，当时金朝拒绝臣服、成为蒙古属国。窝阔台汗派出两支军队围攻开封，一支由他亲自率领，另一支由他的弟弟拖雷统领。

en.t: Philip VI is crowned King of France
en.s: Philip VI (French: Philippe; 1293 – 22 August 1350), called the Fortunate (French: le Fortuné), the Catholic (le Catholique) and of Valois (de Valois), was the first king of France from the House of Valois, reigning from 1328 until his death in 1350. Philip's reign was dominated by the consequences of a succession dispute.

zh.t: 腓力六世加冕为法国国王
zh.s: 腓力六世（法语：Philippe；1293年—1350年8月22日），称“幸运者”（法语：le Fortuné）、“天主教徒”（le Catholique）和“瓦卢瓦”（de Valois），是瓦卢瓦王朝首位法国国王，1328年至1350年去世期间在位。他的统治深受王位继承争端的影响。

en.s: The Battle of Trancoso was fought on 29 May 1385 between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Crown of Castile. Following the coronation of João of Aviz, John I of Castile sent an army into the Portuguese region of Beira in retaliation for Portuguese defiance, where they committed all the kinds of atrocities. The city of Viseu was pillaged and burned, but when the Castilians were returning to Castile with their plundered loot and the prisoners they had taken, a Portuguese army met them, dismounted and assumed a defensive formation.

zh.s: 1385年5月29日，葡萄牙王国与卡斯蒂利亚王权在特兰科索交战。阿维斯的若昂加冕后，卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世为报复葡萄牙的抗命，派军进入葡萄牙贝拉地区，沿途犯下各种暴行。维塞乌城遭到洗劫和焚烧。卡斯蒂利亚军队带着掠夺物和俘虏返回卡斯蒂利亚时，葡萄牙军队迎面截住他们，下马列阵防守。

en.s: The Battle of Gallipoli occurred on 29 May 1416 between the fleets of the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire off the port city of Gallipoli, the main Ottoman naval base. The battle was the main episode of a brief conflict between the two powers, resulting from Ottoman attacks against possessions and shipping of the Venetians and their allies in the Aegean Sea in 1414–1415.

zh.s: 1416年5月29日，威尼斯共和国舰队与奥斯曼帝国舰队在奥斯曼主要海军基地、港口城市加里波利附近交战。这场战斗是两个强权短暂冲突中的主要事件；冲突起因是奥斯曼帝国于1414至1415年间袭击威尼斯及其盟友在爱琴海的属地和船只。

en.s: Constantinople, the capital city of the Byzantine Empire, was captured by the Ottoman Empire on 29 May 1453 as part of the culmination of a 53-day siege which had begun on 6 April. The attacking Ottoman Army, which significantly outnumbered Constantinople's defenders, was commanded by Sultan Mehmed II (later nicknamed "the Conqueror"), while the Byzantine army was led by Emperor Constantine XI Palaiologos.

zh.s: 1453年5月29日，奥斯曼帝国攻占拜占庭帝国首都君士坦丁堡，结束了从4月6日开始、持续53天的围城。奥斯曼军队人数远多于君士坦丁堡守军，由苏丹穆罕默德二世（后来被称为“征服者”）指挥；拜占庭军队则由皇帝君士坦丁十一世·巴列奥略统率。

en.s: The capture of Peñón of Algiers was accomplished when the beylerbey of Algiers, Hayreddin Barbarossa, captured the fortress called Peñón of Algiers, on a small islet facing the Algerian city of Algiers from the Habsburg Spaniards.

zh.s: 阿尔及尔贝勒贝伊海雷丁·巴巴罗萨从哈布斯堡西班牙人手中攻占阿尔及尔佩尼翁堡。该堡垒位于一座小岛上，正对阿尔及利亚城市阿尔及尔。

en.s: The Battle of Sacheon was a naval engagement on May 29, 1592 (Gregorian: July 8, 1592) during the Imjin War (1592–98). It occurred at Sacheon where Yi Sunsin's fleet managed to destroy 13 large Japanese ships. It was the first battle of Admiral Yi's 2nd Campaign in the Imjin War, between Japan and Korea, when the turtle ship was first used.

zh.s: 泗川海战是壬辰战争期间的一场海战，公历日期为1592年5月29日（格里历：1592年7月8日）。李舜臣率领的舰队在泗川击毁13艘大型日本战船。这是李舜臣在壬辰战争第二次战役中的首战，也是龟船首次投入使用的一场战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Deputy's Pass was fought in County Wicklow on 29 May 1599, during the Nine Years' War in Ireland. A Gaelic Irish force under Felim McFiach O'Byrne ambushed an English army of about 500, under Sir Henry Harrington, which was marching from Rathdrum to Wicklow. The English army was routed and lost about 250 men.

zh.s: 1599年5月29日，爱尔兰九年战争期间，副官隘口战役在威克洛郡发生。费利姆·麦克菲亚赫·奥拜恩率领的盖尔爱尔兰军队伏击了亨利·哈灵顿爵士率领的一支约500人的英军；英军正从拉思德拉姆向威克洛进军。英军被击溃，约有250人阵亡。

en.s: The siege of Cahir Castle took place in Munster, in southern Ireland in 1599, during the campaign of the Earl of Essex against the rebels in the Nine Years War (1595-1603). Although the castle was considered the strongest fortress in the country, Essex took it after only a few days of artillery bombardment. However, Queen Elizabeth dismissed her commander's achievement, claiming the defenders were merely a "rabble of rogues".
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1599年，埃塞克斯伯爵率军镇压叛军期间，卡希尔城堡围城战在爱尔兰南部的芒斯特地区发生，属于九年战争（1595—1603年）的一部分。卡希尔城堡被认为是全国最坚固的要塞，但埃塞克斯仅用数日炮击便攻下城堡。伊丽莎白女王却轻视这位将领的战绩，称守军不过是“一群无赖”。

en.s: The Battle of Villabuona (sometimes spelled "Villabona") was fought on 29 May 1630 in the frazione of Villabona (a locality in the comune of Goito) in southern Lombardy during the Mantuan war of succession between an allied Franco-Venetian army led by the Venetian provveditore Zaccaria Sagredo and the French commander Duc de Candale on one side and the Imperial army of Mathias Gallas on the other.

zh.s: 维拉布奥纳战役有时也拼作“Villabona”，于1630年5月29日在维拉博纳村（戈伊托市镇内的一个地方）发生，地点在伦巴第南部。战役属于曼图亚王位继承战争的一部分，交战双方一方是威尼斯总督扎卡里亚·萨格雷多率领的法威联军及法国指挥官坎代尔公爵，另一方是马蒂亚斯·加拉斯率领的帝国军。

en.s: The Cossack raid on Istanbul (Russian: Казацкий рейд на Стамбул, Ukrainian: Козацький рейд на Стамбул, Turkish: İstanbul'a Kazak baskını; 1652) was conducted by the Don Cossacks of Ataman Ivan Bogatyi against the capital of Ottoman Empire and surrounding areas, on 29 May 1652.

zh.t: 哥萨克袭击伊斯坦布尔（1652年）
zh.s: 顿河哥萨克阿塔曼伊万·博加特伊率部袭击奥斯曼帝国首都及其周边地区，这次行动发生于1652年5月29日。

en.s: Battle of Samugarh, Jang-e-Samugarh, (May 29, 1658), was a decisive battle in the struggle for the throne during the Mughal war of succession (1658–1659) between the sons of the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan after the emperor's serious illness in September 1657. The battle of Samugarh was fought between his sons Dara Shikoh (the eldest son and heir apparent) and his two younger brothers Aurangzeb and Murad Baksh (third and fourth sons of the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan). Dara Shikoh began to retreat towards Samugarh, about 10 miles (16 km) east of Agra, south of the Yamuna River, after Aurangzeb had defeated Dara Shikoh's forces during the Battle of Dharmat.

zh.s: 萨穆加尔战役发生于1658年5月29日，是莫卧儿帝国皇帝沙贾汗的儿子们为争夺王位而进行的继承战争（1658—1659年）中的决定性战役。沙贾汗于1657年9月病重后，长子和王位继承人达拉·舒科与两个弟弟奥朗则布、穆拉德·巴赫什交战。奥朗则布在达尔马特战役中击败达拉·舒科的军队后，达拉开始向萨穆加尔撤退。萨穆加尔位于亚穆纳河以南、阿格拉以东约10英里（16公里）。

en.s: The capture of Giurgiu was a military siege undertaken by the Ottomans between 27 and 29 May 1771 against the city of Giurgiu, occupied by the Russians since February. The siege was part of the Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774), and resulted in an Ottoman victory.

zh.s: 1771年5月27日至29日，奥斯曼军队围攻吉乌尔久城。该城自同年2月起被俄军占领。这次围城是俄土战争（1768—1774年）的一部分，最终以奥斯曼军队获胜告终。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was scheduled to be held in Virginia on May 29, 1777. However, when the Virginia General Assembly met to conduct the election, the incumbent governor of Virginia Patrick Henry was the only candidate nominated. By a joint resolution of the Senate and House of Delegates, balloting was dispensed with and Henry was declared re-elected by acclamation.

zh.s: 原定于1777年5月29日在弗吉尼亚举行州长选举。但州议会召开并进行选举时，现任州长帕特里克·亨利是唯一获提名的候选人。参议院和众议院通过联合决议，取消投票，并宣布亨利在无人反对的情况下连任。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was scheduled to be held in Virginia on May 29, 1778. However, when the Virginia General Assembly met to conduct the election, the incumbent governor of Virginia Patrick Henry was the only candidate nominated. By a joint resolution of the Senate and House of Delegates, balloting was dispensed with and Henry was declared re-elected by acclamation.

en.s: The Battle of Chillicothe was a military engagement of the western theater of the American Revolutionary War. In May 1779, Colonel John Bowman of the Kentucky County militia, accompanied by Benjamin Logan and Levi Todd, led between 160 and 300 militiamen against the Shawnee settlement of Old Chillicothe. Dividing their forces, Bowman and Logan attacked the town from two sides but were eventually repulsed.

zh.s: 奇利科西战役是美国独立战争西部战场的一场军事交锋。1779年5月，肯塔基县民兵上校约翰·鲍曼与本杰明·洛根、利瓦伊·托德率领160至300名民兵，进攻肖尼族聚居地老奇利科西。鲍曼和洛根分兵从两侧进攻，但最终被击退。

en.s: The Battle of Waxhaws (also known as the Waxhaws or Waxhaw massacre, and Buford's massacre) took place during the American Revolutionary War on May 29, 1780, near Lancaster, South Carolina, between a Continental Army force led by Abraham Buford and a mainly Loyalist force led by British officer Banastre Tarleton. Buford refused an initial demand to surrender, but when his men were attacked by Tarleton's cavalry, many threw down their arms to surrender. Buford apparently attempted to surrender, however, the British commanding officer Tarleton was shot at during the truce, having his horse fall and trap him.

zh.s: 瓦克斯霍战役又称瓦克斯霍大屠杀、瓦克斯霍惨案或布福德惨案，于1780年5月29日在美国独立战争期间发生，地点靠近南卡罗来纳州兰开斯特。亚伯拉罕·布福德率领大陆军，与英国军官巴纳斯特·塔尔顿率领、主要由效忠派组成的部队交战。布福德拒绝了最初的投降要求，但塔尔顿的骑兵发动攻击后，许多人放下武器投降。布福德显然也试图投降；不过，休战期间英军指挥官塔尔顿遭到枪击，战马倒下并将他压住。

en.s: The Battle off Halifax took place on 28 May 1782 during the American Revolutionary War. It involved the American privateer Jack and the 14-gun Royal Naval brig HMS Observer off Halifax, Nova Scotia. Captain David Ropes commanded Jack, and Lieutenant John Crymes commanded Observer. The battle was "a long and severe engagement" in which Captain David Ropes was killed.

zh.s: 哈利法克斯海战发生于1782年5月28日美国独立战争期间，交战双方为美国私掠船“杰克号”和一艘装备14门火炮的英国皇家海军双桅纵帆船“观察者号”，地点在新斯科舍省哈利法克斯近海。“杰克号”由戴维·罗普斯船长指挥，“观察者号”由约翰·克赖姆斯中尉指挥。这是一场“持续时间长、战况激烈”的交战，戴维·罗普斯船长阵亡。

en.t: Rhode Island becomes the last of North America's original Thirteen Colonies to ratify the Constitution and become one of the United States
en.s: Rhode Island ( ROHD) is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Connecticut to its west; Massachusetts to its north and east; and the Atlantic Ocean to its south via Rhode Island Sound and Block Island Sound; and shares a small maritime border with New York, east of Long Island.

zh.t: 罗得岛成为北美原十三殖民地中最后一个批准宪法、加入美国的地区
zh.s: 罗得岛（读作ROHD）是美国东北部新英格兰地区的一个州。西邻康涅狄格州，北部和东部与马萨诸塞州接壤，南临大西洋，隔罗得岛海峡和布洛克岛海峡相望；长岛以东还与纽约州有一小段海上边界。

en.s: The frigate action of 29 May 1794—not to be confused with the much larger fleet action of 29 May 1794 that took place in the same waters at the same time—was a minor naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars between a Royal Navy frigate and a French Navy frigate.

zh.s: 1794年5月29日的护卫舰交战，是法国大革命战争期间英国皇家海军一艘护卫舰与法国海军一艘护卫舰之间的小规模海战。不要将其与同一时间、同一海域发生、规模大得多的1794年5月29日舰队战混淆。

en.s: The siege of Collioure (6 – 29 May 1794) saw a Republican French army led by Jacques François Dugommier invest the French port of Collioure held by a Spanish garrison commanded by Eugenio Navarro. The actual siege work was carried out by Pierre François Sauret's reinforced division. After the three-and-a-half-week War of the Pyrenees siege, the Spanish fleet sent to evacuate the garrison was blown off station by a storm.

zh.s: 1794年5月6日至29日，雅克-弗朗索瓦·迪戈米耶率领的法国共和军围困了由欧亨尼奥·纳瓦罗指挥的西班牙驻军控制的法国港口科利乌尔。实际围城由皮埃尔-弗朗索瓦·索雷率领的增援师执行。比利牛斯战争期间，这场围城持续了三个半星期。西班牙派去撤离驻军的舰队遭遇风暴，被吹离原定位置。

en.t: United Irishmen Rebellion: Between 300 and 500 United Irishmen are executed as rebels by the British Army in County Kildare, Ireland
en.s: The Gibbet Rath executions , sometimes called the Gibbet Rath massacre, refers to the execution of several hundred surrendering rebels by government forces during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 at the Curragh of Kildare on 29 May 1798.

zh.t: 爱尔兰人联合会起义：英军在基尔代尔郡处决300至500名起义者
zh.s: 吉贝特拉斯处决事件有时也称吉贝特拉斯大屠杀，指1798年爱尔兰起义期间，政府军于1798年5月29日在基尔代尔郡柯拉赫处决数百名已投降的起义者。

en.s: The Second Battle of Sacket's Harbor, or simply the Battle of Sacket's Harbor, took place on 29 May 1813, during the War of 1812. A British force was transported across Lake Ontario and attempted to capture the town, which was the principal dockyard and base for the American naval squadron on the lake. Twelve warships were built here.

zh.s: 第二次萨基特港战役，也简称萨基特港战役，发生于1812年战争期间，日期为1813年5月29日。英军乘船横渡安大略湖，试图攻占该镇；萨基特港是美国在湖上的海军中队主要造船厂和基地，当地共建造了12艘军舰。

en.t: Coronation of Charles X of France
en.s: The coronation of Charles X took place on 29 May 1825 in Reims, where he was crowned King of France and Navarre. The ceremony was held at the Cathedral of Notre-Dame de Reims in Reims, the traditional site for the coronations of the Kings of France. It was the first coronation since Louis XVI's in 1775, and marked the final coronation of a French monarch, as Louis Philippe I and Napoleon III were only proclaimed monarch.

zh.t: 法国国王查理十世加冕
zh.s: 查理十世于1825年5月29日在兰斯加冕为法国和纳瓦拉国王。仪式在兰斯圣母主教座堂举行，这里是法国国王传统的加冕地点。自1775年路易十六加冕以来，这是法国首次举行国王加冕典礼，也是法国君主的最后一次加冕；路易-菲利普一世和拿破仑三世后来都只是被宣布为君主。

en.s: The Battle of Rajgród was a battle fought on 29 May 1831 between Poland and Imperial Russia, during the November Uprising. The Poles, according to some accounts, were victorious.

zh.s: 1831年5月29日，波兰与俄罗斯帝国在十一月起义期间于拉伊格鲁德交战。据一些记载，波兰方面获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Williams Station was a minor skirmish during the Pyramid Lake War of 1860. The fight took place following the defeat of Major William Ormsby at the First Battle of Pyramid Lake as U.S. Volunteers entered the war.

zh.s: 威廉斯站战役是1860年金字塔湖战争期间的一场小规模冲突。奥姆斯比少校在金字塔湖第一次战役中战败后，美国志愿兵进入战场，随后在威廉斯站发生了这场交战。

en.s: The Battle of Aquia Creek was an exchange of cannon fire between Union Navy gunboats and Confederate shore batteries on the Potomac River at its confluence with Aquia Creek in Stafford County, Virginia. The battle took place from May 29, 1861 to June 1, 1861 during the early days of the American Civil War. The Confederates set up several shore batteries to block Union military and commercial vessels from moving in the Chesapeake Bay and along the lower Potomac River as well as for defensive purposes. The battery at Aquia also was intended to protect the railroad terminal at that location.

zh.s: 阿奎亚溪战役是联邦海军炮艇与邦联岸防炮台之间的一场炮战，地点在波托马克河与阿奎亚溪交汇处，位于弗吉尼亚州斯塔福德县。战斗发生于1861年5月29日至6月1日，是美国内战初期的战事之一。邦联军队设置了数座岸防炮台，阻止联邦军用和商用船只在切萨皮克湾及波托马克河下游航行，同时也用于防御。阿奎亚的炮台还负责保护当地的铁路终点站。

en.t: The Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce is founded, in Hong Kong
en.s: The Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce (HKGCC; Chinese: 香港總商會) was founded on 29 May 1861, and is the oldest and one of the largest business organizations in Hong Kong, marking a historic milestone of 165 years of service in 2026. It has thousands of corporate members, who combined employ around one-third of Hong Kong's workforce.

zh.s: 香港总商会（HKGCC；中文：香港總商會）成立于1861年5月29日，是香港历史最悠久、规模最大的商会之一。到2026年，该会将迎来成立165周年。商会拥有数千家企业会员，这些企业雇用的员工合计约占香港劳动力的三分之一。

en.s: The First Battle of Pocotaligo was a battle in the American Civil War fought on May 29, 1862 near Yemassee, South Carolina. The Union objective was to sever the Charleston and Savannah Railroad and thus isolate Charleston, South Carolina.

zh.t: 第一次波科塔利戈战役
zh.s: 第一次波科塔利戈战役是美国内战期间的一场战斗，于1862年5月29日在南卡罗来纳州耶马西附近发生。联邦军的目标是切断查尔斯顿—萨凡纳铁路，从而孤立南卡罗来纳州的查尔斯顿。

en.s: The Mayo by-election of 1874 was fought on 29 May 1874. The byelection was fought due to the void Election of the incumbent Home Rule MP, George Ekins Browne. It was retained by Browne.

zh.s: 1874年梅奥选区补选于5月29日举行。原爱尔兰自治党议员乔治·埃金斯·布朗的当选资格被宣告无效，因此举行补选。布朗保住了席位。

en.s: The naval Incident of Pacocha took place on 29 May 1877 when Nicolás de Piérola was leading a revolution to overthrow then Peruvian President Mariano Ignacio Prado. Piérola's supporters used the Peruvian monitor Huáscar as a raiding ship. She harassed the shipping especially off El Callao, the main commercial port of Peru. However, after she boarded some British merchant ships, British authorities sent Rear Admiral de Horsey to capture the vessel. The Peruvian warship managed to outrun the British squadron after a fierce exchange of fire. Huascar guns were undermanned, and the monitor fired just 40 rounds.

zh.s: 帕科查事件发生于1877年5月29日，当时尼古拉斯·德·皮埃罗拉正领导一场推翻秘鲁总统马里亚诺·伊格纳西奥·普拉多的革命。皮埃罗拉的支持者把秘鲁装甲舰“瓦斯卡尔”号用作袭击船，在秘鲁主要商业港口卡亚俄附近等地骚扰航运。该舰又扣押了几艘英国商船后，英国当局派遣海军少将德·霍西前去捕获它。经过激烈交火，秘鲁军舰成功摆脱英国舰队。瓦斯卡尔号人手不足，只发射了40发炮弹。

en.s: The Battle of Biddulphsberg was an engagement of the Second Boer War on May 29, 1900, and was part of the Advance on Pretoria. Troops of the 8th Division were stationed in the Southern regions of the Orange Free State in order to cover Lord Roberts' advance on Transvaal, and to prevent the Orange Free State from falling back under Boer control.

zh.s: 比杜尔夫斯贝格战役是第二次布尔战争中的一场战斗，发生于1900年5月29日，属于向比勒陀利亚推进战役的一部分。第八师的部队驻扎在奥兰治自由邦南部，以掩护罗伯茨勋爵向德兰士瓦推进，并防止奥兰治自由邦重新落入布尔人控制。

en.t: N'Djamena, now the capital of Chad, was founded as Fort-Lamy by French commander Émile Gentil
en.s: N'Djamena (English: ən-jah-MAY-nə) is the capital and largest city of Chad. It is also a Special Status Province, divided into 10 districts or arrondissements. Originally called Fort-Lamy, it was founded in 1910 by the French during their colonization of Central Africa. The city was renamed N'Djamena in 1975, reflecting its local Chadian heritage.

zh.t: 乍得现首都恩贾梅纳由法国指挥官埃米尔·让蒂尔建立，最初名为拉米堡
zh.s: 恩贾梅纳（英语读作：ən-jah-MAY-nə）是乍得首都和最大城市，也是一处特殊地位省份，下辖10个区。该市最初名为拉米堡，由法国人于1910年殖民中非期间建立，1975年改名恩贾梅纳，以体现当地乍得文化传统。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1902 was the tenth general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on May 29, 1902, to elect the 98 Members of the 10th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Sir George William Ross, formed the government for a ninth consecutive term, although with only a very slim, two-seat majority in the Legislature. The Ontario Conservative Party, led by Sir James P. Whitney formed the official opposition.

zh.s: 1902年5月29日，加拿大安大略省举行第十次大选，选出第十届省议会的98名议员。乔治·威廉·罗斯爵士领导的安大略自由党连续第九届组建政府，但在议会中的多数优势仅有两席。詹姆斯·惠特尼爵士领导的安大略保守党组成官方反对党。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 29 May 1904.The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 38 of the 81 seats in the Chamber of Representatives. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in four out of the nine provinces: Hainaut, Limburg, Liège and East Flanders.

zh.s: 比利时于1904年5月29日举行部分大选。天主教党获胜，在众议院81个席位中赢得38席。按轮流选举制度，本次只在九个省中的四个省举行选举：埃诺、林堡、列日和东佛兰德。

en.t: During the premiere of the ballet Le Sacre du printemps by Igor Stravinsky at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris, the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography caused a near-riot in the audience (report pictured)
en.s: The Rite of Spring (French: Le Sacre du printemps) is a ballet and orchestral concert work by the Russian composer Igor Stravinsky. It was written for the 1913 Paris season of Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes company; the original choreography was by Vaslav Nijinsky with stage designs and costumes by Nicholas Roerich. When first performed at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées on 29 May 1913, the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography caused a sensation.

zh.t: 斯特拉文斯基芭蕾舞剧《春之祭》在巴黎首演，引发观众近乎骚乱
zh.s: 《春之祭》（法语：Le Sacre du printemps）是俄罗斯作曲家伊戈尔·斯特拉文斯基创作的芭蕾舞剧和管弦乐作品，为谢尔盖·佳吉列夫的俄罗斯芭蕾舞团1913年巴黎演出季创作。原版舞蹈由瓦斯拉夫·尼金斯基编排，舞台设计和服装由尼古拉·雷里赫负责。作品于1913年5月29日在香榭丽舍剧院首演，其前卫的音乐和舞蹈引起轰动。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 29 May 1915. Following the resignation of president Manuel de Arriaga, an election was held to see who would complete the remainder of his term. Portugal's 1911 constitution stated that the Congress of the Republic must elect the president in Lisbon instead of the Portuguese people.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1915年5月29日举行总统选举。总统曼努埃尔·德·阿里亚加辞职后，议会选举继任者完成其剩余任期。根据葡萄牙1911年宪法，总统须由共和国议会在里斯本选出，而非由葡萄牙民众直接选举。

en.s: The Grey by-election of 1918 was a by-election during the 18th New Zealand Parliament. It was held on the 29 May 1918. The seat had become vacant due to the imprisonment of sitting member Paddy Webb who was jailed on the issue of his vocal opposition to conscription which had been enforced by Prime Minister William Massey. The by-election was won by the Labour candidate Harry Holland.

zh.s: 1918年格雷选区补选是在新西兰第十八届议会期间举行的一次补选，投票日为1918年5月29日。现任议员帕迪·韦伯因公开反对由首相威廉·梅西推动实施的征兵制而入狱，议席因此出缺。工党候选人哈里·霍兰德赢得补选。

en.t: Armenia defeats the Ottoman Army in the Battle of Sardarabad
en.s: The Battle of Sardarabad (Armenian: Սարդարապատի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Sardarapati chakatamart; Turkish: Serdarabad Muharebesi) was a battle of the Caucasus campaign of World War I that took place near Sardarabad, Armenia, from 21 to 29 May 1918, between the regular Armenian military units and militia on one side and the Ottoman army that had invaded Eastern Armenia on the other.

zh.t: 亚美尼亚在萨达拉帕特战役中击败奥斯曼军队
zh.s: 萨达拉帕特战役是第一次世界大战高加索战役的一部分，发生于1918年5月21日至29日，地点在亚美尼亚萨达拉帕特附近。交战双方一边是亚美尼亚正规军和民兵，另一边是入侵亚美尼亚东部的奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The 1919 South American Championship play-off was a match held to determine the winner of the 1919 South American Championship, the third edition of this continental championship, as Brazil and Uruguay were tied for the first place after the regular competition. The match took place on May 29, 1919, at Estádio das Laranjeiras in Rio de Janeiro. Brazil won 1–0 after two extra time periods of two 30-minute halves each.

zh.s: 1919年南美足球锦标赛附加赛用于决出该届赛事冠军。巴西和乌拉圭在常规比赛后并列第一，因此进行这场决胜比赛。这是第三届南美足球锦标赛。比赛于1919年5月29日在里约热内卢拉兰热拉斯体育场举行。加时赛分为两个各30分钟的半场，巴西最终以1比0获胜。

en.s: A total solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's descending node of orbit on Thursday, May 29, 1919, with a magnitude of 1.0719. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby totally or partly obscuring the image of the Sun for a viewer on Earth. A total solar eclipse occurs when the Moon's apparent diameter is larger than the Sun's, blocking all direct sunlight, turning day into darkness.
en.n: A total solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's descending node of orbit on Thursday, May 29, 1919, with a magnitude of 1.0719.

zh.s: 1919年5月29日星期四，月球在轨道下降交点发生了一次日全食，食分为1.0719。日食发生时，月球经过地球与太阳之间，从地球上的观察者看来，太阳会被全部或部分遮挡。日全食发生在月球的视直径大于太阳时，月球遮住所有直射阳光，使白昼变暗。
zh.n: 1919年5月29日星期四，月球在轨道下降交点发生了一次日全食，食分为1.0719。

en.s: The 1920 Louth flood was a severe flash flooding event in the Lincolnshire market town of Louth which occurred on 29 May 1920, resulting in 23 fatalities in 20 minutes. It has been described as one of the most significant flood disasters in Britain or Ireland during the 20th century.

zh.s: 1920年5月29日，林肯郡集镇劳斯发生严重的突发洪水，20分钟内造成23人死亡。这场洪灾被称为20世纪英国或爱尔兰最严重的洪灾之一。

en.s: The Battle of Luding Bridge (simplified Chinese: 泸定桥战斗; traditional Chinese: 瀘定橋戰鬥; pinyin: Lúdìng Qiáo Zhàndòu) of 1935 was a controversial crossing of the Luding Bridge by the soldiers of the Fourth Regiment of the Chinese Workers and Peasants' Red Army during the Long March. The bridge, situated over the Dadu River in Luding County, Garzê Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan, China, was located about 80 kilometers west of the city of Ya'an and was a river crossing vital to the Red Army.

zh.s: 泸定桥战斗（简体中文：泸定桥战斗；繁体中文：瀘定橋戰鬥；拼音：Lúdìng Qiáo Zhàndòu）是1935年中国工农红军长征途中，红四团战士强渡泸定桥的一次战斗。这座桥横跨大渡河，位于中国四川省甘孜藏族自治州泸定县，距雅安市以西约80公里，是红军必须通过的重要渡口。

en.t: First flight of the Messerschmitt Bf 109 fighter aeroplane
en.s: The Messerschmitt Bf 109 is a monoplane fighter aircraft that was designed and initially produced by the German aircraft manufacturer Bayerische Flugzeugwerke (BFW). Together with the Focke-Wulf Fw 190, the Bf 109 formed the backbone of the Luftwaffe's fighter force during the Second World War. It was commonly called the Me 109 by Allied aircrew and some German aces/pilots, even though this was not the official model designation.

zh.t: 梅塞施密特Bf 109战斗机首飞
zh.s: 梅塞施密特Bf 109是一款单翼战斗机，由德国飞机制造商巴伐利亚飞机制造厂（BFW）设计并最初生产。二战期间，它与福克-沃尔夫Fw 190共同构成德国空军战斗机部队的主力。盟军机组人员和部分德国王牌飞行员常称它为Me 109，但这并非正式型号名称。

en.s: The Deutschland incident of 1937 occurred in May of that year, during the Spanish Civil War. On 29 May 1937, a pair of Tupolev SB Soviet bombers attached to the Spanish Republican Air Force raided Nationalist air bases and the port of Ibiza, in the Mediterranean Sea. The aircraft departed from the airbase of Los Alcázares, near Cartagena.

zh.s: 德意志号事件发生于1937年5月，正值西班牙内战期间。1937年5月29日，两架苏联图波列夫SB轰炸机编入西班牙共和军空军，袭击了国民军空军基地和地中海的伊维萨港。这些飞机从卡塔赫纳附近的洛斯阿尔卡萨雷斯空军基地起飞。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 28 and 29 May 1939. The result was a victory for the Party of Hungarian Life, which won 181 of the 260 seats in Parliament. Pál Teleki remained Prime Minister.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1939年5月28日至29日举行议会选举。匈牙利生活党获胜，在议会260个席位中赢得181席。帕尔·特莱基继续担任总理。

en.s: The Battle of Rethymno was part of the Battle of Crete, fought during World War II on the Greek island of Crete between 20 and 29 May 1941. Australian and Greek forces commanded by Lieutenant-colonel Ian Campbell defended the town of Rethymno and the nearby airstrip against a German paratrooper attack by the 2nd Parachute Regiment of the 7th Air Division commanded by Colonel Alfred Sturm.

zh.s: 雷西姆诺战役是克里特岛战役的一部分，第二次世界大战期间于1941年5月20日至29日在希腊克里特岛发生。伊恩·坎贝尔中校指挥的澳大利亚和希腊部队，守卫雷西姆诺镇及附近机场，抵挡阿尔弗雷德·施图姆上校指挥的德军第七航空师第二伞兵团进攻。

en.s: Operation Steinbock or Operation Capricorn (German: Unternehmen Steinbock), sometimes called the Baby Blitz or Little Blitz, was a strategic bombing campaign by the German Air Force (Luftwaffe) during the Second World War. It comprised attacks on southern England and lasted from January to May 1944. Steinbock was the last strategic air offensive by the German bomber arm during the conflict.

zh.s: 山羊座行动（德语：Unternehmen Steinbock）是德国空军在第二次世界大战期间发动的一场战略轰炸行动，也称“小闪电战”或“婴儿闪电战”。行动袭击英格兰南部，持续时间为1944年1月至5月。这是德国轰炸机部队在战争期间最后一次战略空袭行动。

en.t: United Airlines Flight 521 crashes at LaGuardia Airport, killing 43
en.s: United Air Lines Flight 521 was a scheduled passenger flight operated by a Douglas DC-4 from LaGuardia Airport, New York City, United States, to Cleveland, Ohio, United States. On May 29, 1947, while attempting to take off on runway 18, the aircraft failed to get airborne, overran the end of the runway, ripped through an airport fence onto traffic on the Grand Central Parkway, and slammed into an embankment, ultimately plunging into a pond and exploding.

zh.t: 美国联合航空521号班机在拉瓜迪亚机场坠毁，43人遇难
zh.s: 美国联合航空521号班机是一趟定期客运航班，由道格拉斯DC-4型飞机执飞，从美国纽约市拉瓜迪亚机场飞往俄亥俄州克利夫兰。1947年5月29日，飞机试图从18号跑道起飞时未能升空，冲出跑道尽头，穿过机场围栏撞上大中央公园大道上的车辆，随后撞上堤岸，最终坠入池塘并爆炸。

en.s: The Yanzhou campaign (Chinese: 兖州战役; pinyin: Yǎnzhōu Zhànyì), also known as the campaign at the central section of the Tianjin-Pukou Railway (Chinese: 津浦路中段战役; pinyin: Jīn Pŭ Lù Zhōng Duàn Zhànyì), was a series of battles fought between the nationalists and the communists for the control of the town Yanzhou, which is today under the administration of Jining, and the region to the north of the town in Shandong, China during the Chinese Civil War in the post World War II era, and resulted in communist victory.

en.t: United Nations Truce Supervision Organization is founded
en.s: The United Nations Truce Supervision Organization (UNTSO) is an organization founded on 29 May 1948 for peacekeeping in the Middle East. Established amidst the 1948 Arab–Israeli War, its primary task was initially to provide the military command structure to the peacekeeping forces in the Middle East to enable the peacekeepers to observe and maintain the ceasefire, and in assisting the parties to the Armistice Agreements in the supervision of the application and observance of the terms of those Agreements.

zh.t: 联合国停战监督组织成立
zh.s: 联合国停战监督组织（UNTSO）成立于1948年5月29日，负责中东地区的维和工作。该组织在1948年阿以战争期间成立，最初的主要任务是为中东维和部队提供军事指挥架构，使维和人员能够监督并维持停火，并协助停战协定各方监督和遵守协定条款。

en.s: The Copa del Generalísimo 1949 final was the 47th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Estadio Chamartín in Madrid, on 29 May 1949, being won by Valencia CF, who beat Atlético de Bilbao 1–0.

zh.s: 1949年佛朗哥杯（国王杯）决赛是该赛事的第47届决赛。决赛于1949年5月29日在马德里的查马丁体育场举行，瓦伦西亚以1比0击败毕尔巴鄂竞技夺冠。

en.t: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary reach Everest’s summit
en.s: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary reached the summit of Mount Everest as members of a British expedition led by John Hunt. Their ascent, made from the Nepalese side of the mountain, became the first confirmed successful climb to the highest point on Earth. The achievement relied on the work of a large expedition, including climbers, high-altitude porters, and support teams who established camps and carried supplies. Hillary and Tenzing spent a short time on the summit before beginning their descent. News of the success traveled internationally and became a defining moment in the history of mountaineering and Himalayan exploration.

zh.t: 丹增·诺尔盖和埃德蒙·希拉里登顶珠穆朗玛峰
zh.s: 丹增·诺尔盖和埃德蒙·希拉里作为约翰·亨特率领的英国探险队成员，登上了珠穆朗玛峰顶峰。他们从尼泊尔一侧登顶，成为有记录以来首批确认成功登上地球最高点的人。这次登顶离不开整支探险队的努力，包括登山者、高海拔背夫和支援队伍；他们搭建营地并运送补给。希拉里和丹增在峰顶短暂停留后开始下撤。成功登顶的消息传遍世界，成为登山史和喜马拉雅探险史上的重要时刻。

en.s: The Battle of Dalushan (Greater Deer Mountain) Islands (大鹿山等岛战斗) was a battle fought between the nationalists and the communists for several islands and islets just off the coast of Zhejiang, China during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era; it resulted in a communist victory. Order of battle: * Nationalists: * The 42nd Column of the Anti-Communist Assault Army * Communists: * A battalion of the 179th regiment of the 60th Division * Two companies of the 17th Public Security Division On May 29, 1953, a battalion of the 179th regiment of the 60th Division and two companies of the 17th Public Security Division launched their assault on Da Lu Shan Dao (大鹿山岛, "Greater Deer Mountain Island"), Xiao Lu Shan Dao, (小鹿山岛, "Lesser Deer Mountain Island"), Ji Guan Shan Dao (鸡冠山岛, "Rooster’s Crown Mountain Island"), and Yang Yu (羊屿, "Goat Islet") off coast of Zhejiang.

zh.s: 大鹿山等岛战斗发生于第二次世界大战结束后的中国内战期间，国民党与共产党军队争夺浙江沿海的数个岛屿，最终共产党获胜。战斗序列如下：国民党方面为反共突击军第四十二纵队；共产党方面为第六十师第一七九团一个营，以及第十七公安师两个连。1953年5月29日，第六十师第一七九团一个营和第十七公安师两个连发起进攻，目标包括大鹿山岛、小鹿山岛、鸡冠山岛和羊屿，这些岛屿位于浙江沿海。

en.s: The Battle of the Nevada Complex was fought between 25 and 29 May 1953 during the Korean War between United Nations Command (UN) and Chinese forces over several front line outposts. After suffering heavy losses the UN abandoned the positions.

zh.s: 朝鲜战争期间，联合国军与中国军队于1953年5月25日至29日围绕几处前线阵地交战。联合国军遭受重大伤亡后放弃了这些阵地。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 29 May 1954. All 121 seats in the House of Representatives were up for election, no Senate election took place. The incumbent Liberal Party of Australia led by Prime Minister of Australia Robert Menzies with coalition partner the Country Party led by Arthur Fadden defeated the Australian Labor Party led by Herbert Evatt.

en.s: The 1955 Coupe de France final was a football match held on 29 May 1955 at the Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir in Colombes, France. It was the final of the 1954–55 edition of the Coupe de France. The match saw Lille defeat Bordeaux 5–2 thanks to goals by Jean Vincent, Yvon Douis (2), and Gérard Bourbotte (2).

zh.s: 1955年法国杯决赛于1955年5月29日在法国科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行，是1954—55赛季法国杯的决赛。里尔以5比2击败波尔多，进球者为让·樊尚、伊冯·杜瓦（两球）和热拉尔·布尔博特（两球）。

en.t: Established as Hong Kong's first television service under the name Rediffusion Television () on 29 May 1957, it shifted to terrestrial television in 1973 and was renamed Asia Television (ATV) in 1982
en.s: Asia Television Limited (Chinese: 亞洲電視有限公司, also known as ATV) is a digital media and broadcasting company in Hong Kong. Established as Hong Kong's first television service under the name Rediffusion Television (麗的電視/麗的呼聲) on 29 May 1957, it shifted to terrestrial television in 1973 and was renamed Asia Television (ATV) in 1982. ATV operated two principal over-the-air channels: the Cantonese ATV Home and the English ATV World.

zh.t: 香港首个电视服务以“丽的电视”之名开播
zh.s: 亚洲电视有限公司（中文：亞洲電視有限公司，简称ATV）是一家香港数字媒体和广播公司。1957年5月29日，它以“丽的电视”（麗的電視／麗的呼聲）之名开办香港首个电视服务；1973年改为地面电视，1982年更名为亚洲电视。亚洲电视运营两个主要无线频道：粤语频道本港台和英语频道国际台。

en.s: United Arab Republic v Sudan was the decisive match of group stage at the 1959 African Cup of Nations. The match was played at the Prince Farouk Stadium in Cairo on 29 May 1959. Unlike other Africa Cup of Nations, the 1959 winner was determined by a group stage, with three teams playing in round-robin format, instead of a knockout stage.

zh.t: 阿联共和国对苏丹（1959年非洲国家杯）

en.s: Nguyễn Khánh (Vietnamese: [ŋwiəŋ˨˩˦ kʰan˦˥]}; 8 November 1927 – 11 January 2013) was a Vietnamese military officer and politician. zh.t: 南越领导人阮庆判处政敌陈文敦和黎文金“道德松懈”罪
zh.s: 阮庆（越南语发音：[ŋwiəŋ˨˩˦ kʰan˦˥]；1927年11月8日—2013年1月11日）是越南军官和政治家，曾任越南共和国陆军将领。1964年1月至1965年2月，他领导南越军政府，期间先后担任国家元首和总理等职务。

en.s: The 1968 European Cup final was the final match of the 1967–68 European Cup, the premier club football competition in Europe. It was played at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 29 May 1968 between Benfica of Portugal and Manchester United of England in front of a crowd of 92,225.

en.s: A by-election was held in the Barbadian constituency of the city of Bridgetown on 29 May 1969 after the death of Barbados National Party member Louis Lynch who was the representative of the constituency in the House of Assembly of Barbados. It was the first election held after Barbados gained independence from the British Empire in 1966.

zh.s: 巴巴多斯布里奇敦市选区于1969年5月29日举行补选。巴巴多斯民族党议员路易斯·林奇去世后，该议席出缺。林奇原是该选区在巴巴多斯众议院的代表。这是巴巴多斯于1966年脱离大英帝国独立后举行的首场选举。

en.t: SETA, a Finnish LGBT rights organisation, is founded in Helsinki
en.s: LGBTQ people are individuals who are lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, or queer. Other individuals are often included in the group, such as questioning, intersex, asexual, aromantic, and agender, denoted under variants of the initialism "LGBTQ". The group is generally conceived as broadly encompassing all individuals who are part of a sexual or gender minority. Variants of the abbreviation, including LGBTQ+, LGBTQIA, and LGBTQIA+, are also used.

zh.t: 芬兰LGBT权利组织SETA在赫尔辛基成立
zh.s: LGBTQ群体包括女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋、跨性别者和酷儿等人士，也常包括仍在探索自身身份、双性人、无性恋、无浪漫倾向和非二元性别者。“LGBTQ”及其扩展形式“LGBTQ+”“LGBTQIA”和“LGBTQIA+”均用于指代性或性别少数群体。

en.s: The 1980 Greek Super Cup was the 1st edition of the Greek Super Cup, an association football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Alpha Ethniki and Greek Cup competitions. The match took place on 29 May 1980 at Karaiskakis Stadium. The contesting teams were the 1979–80 Alpha Ethniki champions, Olympiacos and the 1979–80 Greek Cup winners, Kastoria. Olympiacos won the match 4–3.

zh.s: 1980年希腊超级杯是首届希腊超级杯，由上赛季甲级联赛和希腊杯冠军进行足球比赛。比赛于1980年5月29日在卡雷斯卡基斯体育场举行。参赛队伍是1979—80赛季甲级联赛冠军奥林匹亚科斯和希腊杯冠军卡斯托里亚。奥林匹亚科斯以4比3获胜。

en.s: The 1982 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1981–82 Taça de Portugal, the 42nd season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 29 May 1982 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Braga and Sporting CP.

zh.s: 1982年葡萄牙杯决赛是1981—82赛季葡萄牙杯的决赛，也是这项由葡萄牙足球协会主办的顶级杯赛的第42个赛季。比赛于1982年5月29日在欧埃拉什的国家体育场举行，参赛双方是葡萄牙足球甲级联赛球队布拉加和葡萄牙体育。

en.s: The Battle of Goose Green (Spanish: Batalla de Pradera del Ganso) was fought from the 28th to the 29th of May 1982 by British and Argentine forces during the Falklands War. Located on East Falkland's central isthmus, the settlement of Goose Green was the site of a tactically vital airfield. Argentine forces were located in a well-defended position within striking distance of San Carlos Water, where the British task force had positioned themselves after their amphibious landing.
en.n: Falklands War: The British Army defeats the Argentine Army at the Battle of Goose Green.

zh.s: 古斯格林战役发生于1982年5月28日至29日，是马岛战争期间英国与阿根廷军队之间的一场战斗。古斯格林定居点位于东福克兰岛中部地峡，那里有一座具有重要战术价值的机场。阿根廷军队占据了防御严密的阵地，距离圣卡洛斯水域不远；英国特遣部队在两栖登陆后驻扎在那里。
zh.n: 福克兰群岛战争：英军在古斯格林战役中击败阿根廷军队。

en.s: The 1982 Israel Super Cup was the 12th Israel Super Cup (17th, including unofficial matches, as the competition wasn't played within the Israel Football Association in its first 5 editions, until 1969), an annual Israel football match played between the winners of the previous season's Top Division and Israel State Cup. The match was played between Hapoel Kfar Saba, champions of the 1981–82 Liga Leumit and Hapoel Yehud, winners of the 1981–82 Israel State Cup.

en.t: 1984 Turks and Caicos Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Turks and Caicos Islands on 29 May 1984. The result was a victory for the ruling Progressive National Party (PNP), which won eight of the eleven seats in the Legislative Council, including Kew North Caicos, where Rosita Butterfield became the islands' first female Legislative Council member. Following the elections, PNP leader Norman Saunders remained Chief Minister.

zh.t: 1984年特克斯和凯科斯群岛大选
zh.s: 特克斯和凯科斯群岛于1984年5月29日举行大选。执政的进步民族党获胜，在立法委员会11个席位中赢得8席。该党在北凯科斯岛的选区也获胜，罗西塔·巴特菲尔德因此成为群岛首位女性立法委员会成员。选举后，进步民族党领袖诺曼·桑德斯继续担任首席部长。

en.s: The Heysel Stadium disaster (pronounced: [ˈɦɛizəl]; Dutch: Heizeldrama; French: Drame du Heysel) occurred on 29 May 1985 when escaping fans were pressed against a collapsing wall in the Heysel Stadium in Brussels, Belgium, before the start of the 1985 European Cup Final between Juventus of Italy and Liverpool of England. 39 people—mostly Italians and Juventus fans—were killed and 600 were injured in the confrontation. Approximately an hour before the Juventus-Liverpool final was due to kick off, Liverpool supporters charged at Juventus fans and breached a fence that was separating them from a "neutral area".

zh.s: 海瑟尔球场惨案发生于1985年5月29日，地点在比利时布鲁塞尔。1985年欧洲冠军杯决赛开始前，逃跑的球迷被挤到海瑟尔球场一堵倒塌的墙边，造成惨剧。39人死亡，其中大多是意大利人和尤文图斯球迷，另有600人受伤。比赛原定由意大利尤文图斯对阵英格兰利物浦；开球前约一小时，利物浦球迷冲向尤文图斯球迷，冲破隔开双方与“中立区”的围栏。

en.s: The 1985 European Cup final was an association football match between Liverpool of England and Juventus of Italy on 29 May 1985 at the Heysel Stadium, Brussels, Belgium. It was the final match of the 1984–85 season of the European Cup, Europe's premier cup competition. Liverpool were the reigning champions and were appearing in their fifth final, having won the competition in 1977, 1978, 1981 and 1984.

zh.s: 1985年5月29日，英格兰利物浦与意大利尤文图斯在比利时布鲁塞尔的海瑟尔球场进行欧洲冠军杯决赛。这是1984—85赛季欧洲冠军杯的最后一场比赛，该赛事是欧洲顶级俱乐部杯赛。利物浦是卫冕冠军，这是他们第五次闯入决赛；此前他们曾于1977、1978、1981和1984年夺冠。

en.s: The Battle of Cadaadley occurred on 29 May 1988 during the Somali Civil War, marking a significant offensive by the Somali National Movement (SNM) against the Somali National Army (SNA). This engagement was part of a broader campaign launched by the SNM across multiple fronts, including Hargeisa and Burco, to destabilize the Somali government’s control in the northern regions.

zh.s: 1988年5月29日，索马里内战期间，索马里民族运动（SNM）对索马里国民军（SNA）发动重要攻势，发生阿达德勒战役（Cadaadley战役）。这场交战是SNM在多个战线上发起的更大规模行动的一部分，行动范围包括哈尔格萨和布拉奥，目的是削弱索马里政府对北部地区的控制。

en.s: The 1988 Associate Members' Cup Final, known as the Sherpa Van Trophy Final for sponsorship reasons, was the 5th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from the Third and Fourth Divisions. The final was played at Wembley Stadium in London on 29 May 1988, The game was contested by Burnley and Wolverhampton Wanderers before a crowd of 80,841, a then record for the trophy, which was not bettered until the 2019 final between Sunderland and Portsmouth.

zh.s: 1988年英格兰联赛杯决赛因赞助原因称为Sherpa Van Trophy决赛，是英格兰足球第三级和第四级球队参加的国内杯赛第五届决赛。比赛于1988年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛球队是伯恩利和伍尔弗汉普顿流浪者。现场观众达80,841人，创下当时该赛事的纪录；这一纪录直到2019年桑德兰对朴茨茅斯的决赛才被打破。

en.s: A regional election was held in Catalonia on 29 May 1988 to elect the 3rd Parliament of the autonomous community. All 135 seats in the Parliament were up for election.

zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚于1988年5月29日举行自治区选举，选出自治区第三届议会。议会全部135个席位均进行改选。

en.s: The Moscow Summit was a summit meeting between U.S. President Ronald Reagan and General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union Mikhail Gorbachev. It was held on May 29 – June 2, 1988. Reagan and Gorbachev finalized the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty (INF) after the U.S. Senate's ratification of the treaty in May 1988.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1988年莫斯科峰会是美国总统罗纳德·里根与苏联共产党中央委员会总书记米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫举行的一次峰会，时间为1988年5月29日至6月2日。美国参议院于1988年5月批准《中程核力量条约》后，里根和戈尔巴乔夫完成了该条约的最终确定。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的开始日期。

en.s: The 1989 Prince Edward Island general election was held on May 29, 1989. The campaign resulted in the re-election of the Liberal government of Premier Joe Ghiz. In this election, the Liberals won 60.7% of the popular vote, the highest percentage that a winning party has taken on record in Prince Edward Island. The Progressive Conservatives won two seats despite taking 36 per cent of the popular vote; they were due 12 seats.

zh.s: 爱德华王子岛于1989年5月29日举行大选，竞选后，乔·吉兹领导的自由党政府连任。自由党获得60.7%的普选票，这是该党在爱德华王子岛历次选举中胜选时的最高得票率。进步保守党虽获得36%的普选票，却只赢得两个席位；按比例原本应获得12席。

en.t: The Congress of People's Deputies of Russia elects Boris Yeltsin as President of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic
en.s: Boris Nikolayevich Yeltsin (1 February 1931 – 23 April 2007) was a Soviet and Russian politician who served as President of Russia from 1991 to 1999, having previously served as Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of the Russian SFSR from 1990 to 1991. He was a member of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union (CPSU) from 1961 to 1990.

zh.t: 俄罗斯人民代表大会选举鲍里斯·叶利钦为俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国总统
zh.s: 鲍里斯·尼古拉耶维奇·叶利钦（1931年2月1日—2007年4月23日）是苏联和俄罗斯政治家，1991年至1999年担任俄罗斯总统。此前，他于1990年至1991年担任俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国最高苏维埃主席，并于1961年至1990年加入苏联共产党。

en.s: The 1991 European Cup final was a football match held at the Stadio San Nicola in Bari, Italy, on 29 May 1991, that saw Red Star Belgrade of Yugoslavia defeat Marseille of France in a penalty shoot-out. After normal time and extra time could not separate the two sides, the match was to be decided on penalty kicks.

zh.s: 1991年5月29日，欧洲冠军杯决赛在意大利巴里圣尼古拉体育场举行。南斯拉夫贝尔格莱德红星队通过点球大战击败法国马赛队。双方在常规时间和加时赛中均未分出胜负，因此比赛以点球决胜。

en.s: The 1991 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Ivaylo Stadium in Veliko Tarnovo on 29 May 1991, and was contested between the sides of Levski Sofia and Botev Plovdiv. The match was won by Levski Sofia.

zh.s: 1991年保加利亚杯决赛于1991年5月29日在大特尔诺沃的伊瓦伊洛体育场举行，由索非亚列夫斯基和普罗夫迪夫博特夫交锋。索非亚列夫斯基赢得比赛。

en.t: 1993 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 1993 Football League Third Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 29 May 1993 at Wembley Stadium, London, between York City and Crewe Alexandra. It was to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Third Division to the Second Division.

zh.t: 1993年英格兰足球联赛第三级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1993年英格兰足球联赛第三级联赛升级附加赛决赛于1993年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由约克城对阵克鲁亚历山德拉。比赛决出第四级别联赛升入第二级别联赛的第四支、也是最后一支升级球队。

en.s: The 1993 Scottish Cup final was played between Rangers and Aberdeen at Celtic Park on 29 May 1993. Owing to ground reconstruction at Hampden Park, the fixture was played at another stadium for the first time since 1924. Rangers won the match 2–1, thereby securing a domestic treble. Rangers' scorers were Mark Hateley, scoring in his second consecutive Scottish Cup final, and Neil Murray.

zh.s: 1993年5月29日，格拉斯哥流浪者与阿伯丁在凯尔特人公园球场进行苏格兰杯决赛。由于汉普顿公园球场正在重建，这是该赛事自1924年以来首次改在其他球场举行。格拉斯哥流浪者以2比1获胜，完成国内三冠王。马克·哈特利和尼尔·默里为流浪者进球；哈特利连续第二年在苏格兰杯决赛中进球。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 29 May 1994, with a second round on 19 June. The result was a victory for Ernesto Samper of the Liberal Party, who received 51.1% of the vote in the run-off. During the campaign, the Liberal Party was forced to seek additional funding from the Cali Cartel, which resulted in the Proceso 8000.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚于1994年5月29日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于6月19日举行。自由党的埃内斯托·桑佩尔赢得第二轮，以51.1%的得票率当选。竞选期间，自由党被迫向卡利集团寻求额外资金，后来引发“8000进程”丑闻。

en.s: The 1994 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the Republican Stadium on 29 May 1994. The match was the 3rd Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by FC Chornomorets Odesa and SC Tavriya Simferopol. The 1994 Ukrainian Cup Final was the third to be held in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Chornomorets won on penalty kicks 5–3 after the score was tied 0–0.

zh.s: 1994年乌克兰杯决赛于1994年5月29日在共和国体育场举行，是第三届乌克兰杯决赛。参赛队伍是敖德萨黑海人和辛菲罗波尔塔夫里亚体育俱乐部。决赛第三次在乌克兰首都基辅举行。双方在常规时间战成0比0，黑海人最终以点球5比3获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 8 May 1994, with a second round of voting in 174 of the 176 single member constituencies on 29 May. They resulted in the return to power of the Hungarian Socialist Party, the former Communist party, under the leadership of Gyula Horn, who became prime minister. The Socialists achieved a remarkable revival, winning an overall majority of 209 seats out of 386, up from 33 in 1990.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1994年5月8日举行议会选举，174个单席选区中的第二轮投票于5月29日举行。前共产党匈牙利社会党在久洛·霍恩领导下重新执政，霍恩出任总理。社会党大幅反弹，赢得386席中的209席并取得多数，高于1990年的33席。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的第二轮投票日期。

en.t: 1995 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 1995 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 29 May 1995 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Bolton Wanderers and Reading. The match was to determine the second and final team to gain promotion from the Football League First Division, the second tier of English football, to the Premiership.

zh.t: 1995年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1995年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于1995年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由博尔顿流浪者对阵雷丁。比赛决出英格兰足球第二级别甲级联赛升入英超的第二支、也是最后一支升级球队。

en.s: General elections were held in Israel on 29 May 1996. For the first time the Prime Minister was elected on a separate ballot from the remaining members of the Knesset. The 1996 elections resulted in a surprise victory for Netanyahu by a margin of 29,457 votes, less than 1% of the total number of votes cast, and much smaller than the number of spoiled votes. This came after the initial exit polls had predicted a Peres win, spawning the phrase "went to sleep with Peres, woke up with Netanyahu." This election was Peres's fourth and last election defeat.

zh.s: 以色列于1996年5月29日举行大选。这是总理首次单独接受投票选举，议会其他成员则通过另一张选票选出。内塔尼亚胡意外获胜，领先29,457票，不到总票数的1%；这一差距远小于废票数量。此前，初步出口民调预测佩雷斯获胜，因此出现了“睡前以为佩雷斯赢了，醒来却发现内塔尼亚胡胜出”的说法。这是佩雷斯第四次、也是最后一次在选举中落败。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Indonesia on 29 May 1997. There were three simultaneous elections in one because voters were electing members of two levels of regional government (provincial and regency levels) as well as the national-level People's Representative Council. This was the last election of President Suharto's New Order regime, which collapsed one year later. Like the preceding New Order elections, it was won outright by the Golkar organization.

zh.t: 1997年印度尼西亚立法机构选举
zh.s: 印度尼西亚于1997年5月29日举行立法机构选举。选民同时选出两级地方政府（省级和县级）的议员，以及国家级人民代表会议的议员，因此实际上是三场同步选举。这是苏哈托新秩序政权时期最后一次选举；该政权于一年后垮台。与此前新秩序时期的选举一样，专业集团党直接获胜。

en.s: The 1999 United States House of Representatives special election in Louisiana's 1st congressional district was held on May 29, 1999, to select the successor to Bob Livingston (R) who resigned due to the discovery of an extramarital affair. On May 1, nine candidates, mostly Republicans, competed on the same ballot. However, since no candidate was able to achieve a majority, a runoff was held at the end of the month.

zh.t: 1999年路易斯安那州第一国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 1999年5月29日，美国举行路易斯安那州第一国会选区特别选举，以选出接替鲍勃·利文斯顿（共和党）的人选；他因婚外情曝光而辞职。5月1日，九名候选人（大多是共和党人）参加同场投票，但无人获得多数，因此在月底举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 1999 Scottish Cup Final was played on 29 May 1999, at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 114th Scottish Cup. Celtic and Rangers contested the match, Rangers won the match 1–0, thanks to Rod Wallace's 48th-minute goal where he shot left footed into the corner of the goal when the ball broke to him in the box four yards out.

zh.s: 1999年苏格兰杯决赛于1999年5月29日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第114届苏格兰杯的决赛。凯尔特人与格拉斯哥流浪者交锋，流浪者以1比0获胜。罗德·华莱士在第48分钟进球：球在距离球门四码处落到他脚下后，他用左脚将球射入球门一角。

en.s: Space Shuttle Discovery (Orbiter Vehicle Designation: OV-103) is a retired American Space Shuttle orbiter. The spaceplane was one of the orbiters from NASA's Space Shuttle program and the third of five fully operational orbiters to be built. Its first mission, STS-41-D, flew from August 30 to September 5, 1984. Over 27 years of service it launched and landed 39 times, aggregating more spaceflights than any other spacecraft as of December 2024.
en.n: Space Shuttle Discovery completes the first docking with the International Space Station.

zh.s: 发现号航天飞机（轨道器编号：OV-103）是已退役的美国航天飞机轨道器，曾执行美国国家航空航天局的航天飞机计划任务，也是建造的5架完全投入使用的轨道器中第三架。它的首次任务STS-41-D于1984年8月30日至9月5日执行。在27年服役期间，它发射并着陆39次；截至2024年12月，执行的太空飞行次数超过任何其他航天器。
zh.n: 发现号航天飞机首次与国际空间站完成对接。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Slovakia on 15 May 1999, with a second round on 29 May. Following a constitutional amendment in 1998 that introduced direct presidential elections for the first time, they resulted in a victory for Rudolf Schuster, who received 57% of the vote in the run-off.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于1999年5月15日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于5月29日举行。1998年宪法修正案首次规定总统由选民直接选举。最后，鲁道夫·舒斯特获胜，在第二轮投票中获得57%的选票。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: Chief Olusegun Matthew Okikiola Ogunboye Aremu Obasanjo ( ; Yoruba: Olúṣẹ́gun Ọbásanjọ́ [ōlúʃɛ́ɡũ̄ ɔ̄básã̄d͡ʒɔ́] ; born c. 5 March 1937) is a Nigerian politician, statesman, agriculturalist, and former army general who served as Nigeria's Military Head of State from 1976 to 1979 and later as its president from 1999 to 2007. Ideologically a Nigerian nationalist, he was a member of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) from 1998 to 2015, and since 2018.

zh.t: 奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔就任尼日利亚总统
zh.s: 奥卢塞贡·马修·奥基基奥拉·奥贡博耶·阿雷穆·奥巴桑乔（约1937年3月5日生）是尼日利亚政治家、国务活动家、农业学家和退役陆军将领。1976年至1979年担任尼日利亚军政府国家元首，之后于1999年至2007年担任总统。他是尼日利亚民族主义者，1998年至2015年以及2018年起为人民民主党（PDP）成员。

en.t: 2000 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 2000 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match played at Wembley Stadium on 29 May 2000, to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the First Division to the Premiership in the 1999–2000 season. Ipswich Town faced Barnsley in the last domestic competitive fixture to be played at the original Wembley Stadium.

zh.t: 2000年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2000年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2000年5月29日在温布利球场举行，决出1999—2000赛季从甲级联赛升入英超的第三支、也是最后一支球队。伊普斯维奇镇对阵巴恩斯利。这是旧温布利球场举行的最后一场国内正式比赛。

en.s: PGA Tour, Inc. v. Martin, 532 U.S. 661 (2001), was a decision by the Supreme Court of the United States involving the applicability of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 to professional golf tours. The PGA Tour, the main organizer of professional golf tours in the United States, had required all golfers to walk between shots during the third stage of its qualifying tournament, which it argued was an important aspect of the game.
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: PGA巡回赛公司诉马丁案，案号532 U.S. 661（2001），是美国最高法院的一项判决，涉及《1990年美国残疾人法》是否适用于职业高尔夫巡回赛。PGA巡回赛是美国职业高尔夫巡回赛的主要组织者，曾要求所有选手在资格赛第三阶段的每洞击球之间步行；该组织认为步行是比赛的重要组成部分。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的判决日期。

en.t: 2004 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 2004 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 29 May 2004 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, between Crystal Palace and West Ham United. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League First Division, the second tier of English football, to the FA Premier League.

zh.t: 2004年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2004年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2004年5月29日在卡迪夫千禧球场举行，由水晶宫对阵西汉姆联。比赛决出从英格兰第二级别甲级联赛升入英超的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2004 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2003–04 DFB-Pokal, the 61st season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 29 May 2004 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Werder Bremen won the match 3–2 against second-division Alemannia Aachen, giving them their 5th cup title.

zh.s: 2004年德国杯决赛决出了2003—04赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第61个赛季。比赛于2004年5月29日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。云达不来梅以3比2击败德乙球队亚琛，赢得队史第五座德国杯。

en.s: The 2004 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 29 May 2004, that saw Paris SG defeat LB Châteauroux 1–0 thanks to a goal by Pauleta.

zh.s: 2004年法国杯决赛于2004年5月29日在圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼凭借保莱塔的进球以1比0击败沙托鲁。

en.s: A referendum on the Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe was held in France on 29 May 2005 to decide whether the French government should ratify the proposed constitution of the European Union. The result was a victory for the "no" campaign, with 55% of voters rejecting the treaty on a turnout of 69%.

zh.s: 2005年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2005年5月29日在卡迪夫千禧球场举行，由哈特尔浦联对阵谢菲尔德星期三。比赛决出了从英甲升入英冠的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2005 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the NSC Olimpiyskiy on 29 May 2005. The match was the 14th Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by Shakhtar Donetsk and Dynamo Kyiv. The Olympic stadium is the traditional arena for the Cup final. The game was remembered for involving the most foreign players in the Ukrainian Cup finals: out of 36 players on both teams' rosters, 28 were from outside of Ukraine.

zh.s: 2005年乌克兰杯决赛于2005年5月29日在奥林匹克国家体育场举行，是第14届乌克兰杯决赛。顿涅茨克矿工对阵基辅迪纳摩。奥林匹克体育场是乌克兰杯决赛的传统举办场地。这场比赛因参赛外籍球员人数创纪录而受到关注：两队名单共36人，其中28人来自乌克兰以外。

en.s: The 2005 Russian Cup final decided the winner of the 2004–05 Russian Cup, the 13th season of Russia's main football cup. It was played on 29 May 2005 at the Lokomotiv Stadium in Moscow, between CSKA Moscow and Khimki. CSKA Moscow emerged victorious with a 1–0 win thanks to a 68th-minute header from Yuri Zhirkov.

zh.s: 2005年俄罗斯杯决赛决出了2004—05赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，这是俄罗斯顶级足球杯赛的第13个赛季。比赛于2005年5月29日在莫斯科火车头体育场举行，参赛队伍是莫斯科中央陆军和希姆基。中央陆军凭借尤里·日尔科夫第68分钟的头球，以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 2005 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Willem II and PSV on 29 May 2005 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2004–05 KNVB Cup competition. PSV won 4–0 after goals from Wilfred Bouma, Phillip Cocu, Park Ji-sung and Jan Vennegoor of Hesselink. With this victory, PSV clinched the double, as they had also become champions of the 2004–05 Eredivisie.

zh.s: 2005年荷兰杯决赛于2005年5月29日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，参赛双方是威廉二世和埃因霍温。这是2004—05赛季荷兰杯的决赛。埃因霍温凭借威尔弗雷德·博马、菲利普·科库、朴智星和扬·费内霍尔·奥夫·赫塞林克的进球，以4比0获胜。埃因霍温同时赢得2004—05赛季荷甲冠军，因此实现双冠王。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Rome on 28–29 May 2006 to elect the Mayor of Rome and 60 members of the City Council, as well as the nineteen presidents and more than 400 councillors of the 19 municipi in which the municipality was divided. The two main candidates were the incumbent left-wing Walter Veltroni and the national-conservative Minister of Agriculture Gianni Alemanno.

en.s: The Caravana de Campeones (2008), Spanish for "Caravan of Champions", was a major professional wrestling show produced and scripted by the Mexican Lucha libre promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG). The event took place on May 29, 2008 in IWRG's main arena Arena Naucalpan. and was the first documented instance of IWRG using the Caravana de Campeones title for one of their shows. It would subsequently become an annual event. The 2008 Caravana de Campeones featured a total of six matches, five of which were for IWRG Championships, including determining the first ever holder of the IWRG Intercontinental Lightweight Championship, Freelance.

zh.s: “冠军之旅”（Caravana de Campeones，西班牙语意为“冠军巡游”）是墨西哥摔角推广组织IWRG制作并编排的一场大型职业摔角赛事。赛事于2008年5月29日在IWRG的主场馆纳乌卡尔潘竞技场举行，也是目前有记录以来IWRG首次以“冠军之旅”作为赛事名称。此后它成为年度赛事。2008年的赛事共安排六场比赛，其中五场争夺IWRG各项冠军，包括决出首位IWRG洲际轻量级冠军。

en.s: The 2008 Iceland earthquake was a doublet earthquake that struck on 29 May at 15:46 UTC in southwestern Iceland. The recorded magnitudes of the two main quakes were 5.9 Mw and 5.8 Mw, respectively, giving a composite magnitude of 6.1 Mw. There were no human fatalities, but injuries were reported and a number of sheep were killed.

zh.s: 2010年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2010年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由米尔沃尔对阵斯温顿镇。比赛决出从英甲升入英冠的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The Final of the 2010 Super 14 season, a provincial rugby union competition in the Southern Hemisphere, took place on 29 May 2010 at Orlando Stadium in Soweto, South Africa. The Bulls, based in Pretoria, hosted the Stormers, from Cape Town, in the second all-South African final. The defending champion Bulls won 25–17 to claim their second consecutive title and third in four years.

zh.s: 2010年超级14赛季决赛于2010年5月29日在南非索韦托的奥兰多体育场举行。超级14是南半球各省队参加的橄榄球联盟赛事。来自比勒陀利亚的公牛队主场迎战来自开普敦的风暴队，这是第二次出现全南非球队参加的决赛。卫冕冠军公牛队以25比17获胜，连续第二年夺冠，并在四年内第三次夺冠。

en.s: Dream 14 was a mixed martial arts event held by Fighting and Entertainment Group's mixed martial arts promotion Dream. The event took place on May 29, 2010 in Japan. The event aired live in North America on HDNet.

zh.s: Dream 14是由格斗与娱乐集团旗下综合格斗推广组织Dream举办的一场综合格斗赛事。赛事于2010年5月29日在日本举行，并通过HDNet向北美观众直播。

en.s: The 2009–10 Celtic League Grand Final was the final match of the 2009–10 Celtic League season. The 2009–10 season was the fourth sponsored by Magners and was the first ever Celtic League Grand Final. The final was won by the Ospreys who defeated Leinster by 17–12 at the RDS Arena to win their third Celtic League title, the win ended Leinster's 20-month unbeaten home league record.

zh.s: 2009–10赛季凯尔特联盟总决赛是该赛季的决赛，也是凯尔特联盟历史上的首场总决赛。2009–10赛季是该赛事第四个由Magners赞助的赛季。奥斯普雷队以17比12击败伦斯特队，在都柏林的RDS体育场夺冠，这是球队第三次赢得凯尔特联盟冠军，也终结了伦斯特队长达20个月的主场联赛不败纪录。

zh.t: 2011年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2011年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2011年5月29日在曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场举行，由哈德斯菲尔德镇对阵彼得伯勒联。比赛决出从英甲升入英冠的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2011 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2010–11 Coppa Italia, the top cup competition in Italian football. The match was played at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome on 29 May 2011 between Internazionale and Palermo. Internazionale won by 3–1 to retain the trophy.

zh.s: 2011年意大利杯决赛是2010—11赛季意大利杯的决赛，该赛事是意大利足球的顶级杯赛。比赛于2011年5月29日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，国际米兰对阵巴勒莫。国际米兰以3比1获胜，成功卫冕。

en.s: The 2012 Texas Republican presidential primary was held on May 29, 2012, as part of the 2012 Republican Party primaries for the 2012 U.S. presidential election. 152 delegates to the 2012 Republican National Convention were allocated to the presidential candidates. Former Governor of Massachusetts Mitt Romney ranked first and winner of the primary, Ron Paul, member of the U.S.

zh.t: 2012 年得克萨斯州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2012 年得克萨斯州共和党总统初选于 2012 年 5 月 29 日举行，是 2012 年美国总统选举共和党初选的一部分。该州共分配 152 名代表，参加共和党全国代表大会。前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼排名第一，赢得初选；美国众议院议员朗·保罗排名第二，前参议院共和党会议主席里克·桑托勒姆（已退选）排名第三。

en.s: The 2012 Texas Democratic presidential primary was held on May 29, 2012. Incumbent president Barack Obama, who was running for the nomination without any major opposition, won the primary with 88.18% of the vote. The primary was officially non-binding. From April to June 2012, the state and district conventions awarded all of Texas' 260 pledged delegates to the 2012 Democratic National Convention, with an additional 27 unpledged delegates.

zh.t: 2012年得克萨斯州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 得克萨斯州民主党于2012年5月29日举行总统初选。当时的总统巴拉克·奥巴马在几乎没有主要对手挑战的情况下争取党内提名，以88.18%的得票率赢得初选。这场初选官方上不具约束力。2012年4月至6月期间，得克萨斯州及各选区的党代表大会将该州260名承诺代表分配给2012年民主党全国代表大会，另有27名非承诺代表。

en.s: The 2013 Slovenian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2012–13 Slovenian Football Cup, the 22nd edition of the Slovenian Football Cup, the top knockout tournament of Slovenian football and the second most important football competition in the country after the Slovenian PrvaLiga championship. The match was played on 29 May 2013 at Bonifika Stadium in Koper.

zh.s: 2013年斯洛文尼亚足球杯决赛是2012—13赛季、也是第22届斯洛文尼亚足球杯的决赛。斯洛文尼亚足球杯是该国顶级淘汰赛，也是仅次于斯洛文尼亚甲级联赛冠军赛的第二重要足球赛事。比赛于2013年5月29日在科佩尔的博尼菲卡体育场举行。

en.s: NXT TakeOver was a 2014 professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental territory, NXT. It was the inaugural NXT TakeOver event and took place on Saturday, May 29, 2014, at NXT's home venue at the time, Full Sail University in Winter Park, Florida. The event aired exclusively on the WWE Network.

zh.s: NXT TakeOver是WWE于2014年制作的一场职业摔角直播赛事，仅有其发展联盟NXT的摔角手参加。这是首届NXT TakeOver赛事，于2014年5月29日星期六在当时NXT的主场——佛罗里达州温特帕克的Full Sail大学举行，并通过WWE Network独家播出。

en.s: The 2015 Balochistan local government elections were held in the Pakistani province of Balochistan on 29 May 2015. The elections were held for the first time in the province after the passage of the Balochistan Local Government Act 2013. The elections were contested by a total of 1,260 candidates, including 620 men and 640 women. The Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) emerged as the largest party in the elections, winning 280 seats.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦俾路支省于2015年5月29日举行地方政府选举。这是该省在《2013年俾路支省地方政府法》通过后首次举行此类选举。共有1,260名候选人参选，其中男性620人、女性640人。巴基斯坦统一民族运动党（MQM-P）赢得280个席位，成为选举中最大的政党。

en.s: The 2015 Albanian Cup final was a football match played on 29 May 2015 to decide the winner of the 2014–15 Albanian Cup, the 63rd edition of Albania's primary football cup. The match, contested by FK Kukësi and KF Laçi, took place on 29 May 2015 at Qemal Stafa Stadium in Tirana, and kicked off at 20:00 p.m.

en.s: The 2015 Taça da Liga final was the final match of the 2014–15 Taça da Liga, the eighth season of the Taça da Liga. Trophy holders Benfica beat Marítimo (2–1) to win a record sixth title in the competition. Goal-line technology was introduced in the final, for the first time in Portugal.

en.s: On May 29, 2016, Katiba Macina militants ambushed Togolese peacekeepers in MINUSMA near Sévaré, Mali. The attack was the first deadly attack against UN peacekeepers in Mopti Region during the Mali War, and the first major engagement involving Togolese peacekeepers during the war.

zh.s: 2016年5月29日，马西纳旅武装分子在马里塞瓦雷附近伏击了联合国马里多层面综合稳定团（MINUSMA）的多哥维和人员。这是马里战争期间首次针对联合国维和人员、并造成死亡的袭击，也是多哥维和人员在战争期间首次参与重大交战。

en.s: The 2016 EFL League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 29 May 2016 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Barnsley and Millwall to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL League One to the EFL Championship.

zh.t: 2016年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛

en.s: The 2016 King Cup final was the final match of the 2016 King Cup, the 41st season of Saudi's main football cup, and the 9th season under the current King Cup title. It was played at the King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah on 29 May 2016, between Al-Ahli and Al-Nassr.

zh.s: 2016年沙特国王杯决赛是2016年国王杯的最后一场比赛，也是沙特主要足球杯赛的第41个赛季和采用现行“国王杯”名称后的第9个赛季。比赛于2016年5月29日在吉达阿卜杜拉国王体育城举行，参赛队伍是吉达国民和利雅得胜利。

en.s: The 2016 Iraq FA Cup final was the 25th final of the Iraq FA Cup as a club competition. The match was contested between the Baghdad rivals, Al-Zawraa and Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya, at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad. It was played on 29 May 2016 to be the final match of the competition. Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya made their 7th appearance in the Iraq FA Cup final while Al-Zawraa extended their record to 16 final appearances.

zh.s: 2016年伊拉克足总杯决赛是该项俱乐部赛事的第25届决赛。巴格达两支劲旅扎瓦拉和空军体育俱乐部在巴格达人民体育场交锋。比赛于2016年5月29日举行，是该届赛事的最后一场比赛。空军体育俱乐部第七次闯入决赛，扎瓦拉则将决赛出场纪录扩大到16次。

en.s: The 2016 Hazfi Cup final was the 29th final since 1975. The match was an wonderful for both teams to get a chance to clinch a title after a good season. Zob Ahan was the defending champion in the competition, if they won it would their first time in the club history to win any competition back-to-back. Zob Ahan had the lead but Esteghlal equalized it at the second half.

zh.s: 2016年哈兹菲杯决赛是1975年以来第29届决赛。经过一个出色的赛季，两队都获得了争夺冠军的机会。佐布阿汉是卫冕冠军；如果再次夺冠，这将是俱乐部历史上首次连续赢得任何赛事冠军。佐布阿汉先取得领先，埃斯特格拉尔随后在下半场扳平比分。

en.s: The 2017 EFL Championship play-off final was an association football match that was played on 29 May 2017 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Huddersfield Town and Reading. The match determined the third and final team to gain promotion from the EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.t: 2017年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2017年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛于2017年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由哈德斯菲尔德镇对阵雷丁。比赛决出从英冠（英格兰第二级别联赛）升入英超的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The Qaboun offensive (2017) was a military operation of the Syrian Arab Army in the suburbs of Damascus against rebel forces during the Syrian Civil War. Its intended goal was to capture the Damascus suburbs of Qaboun and Barzeh from rebels led by Hay’at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2017年卡本攻势是叙利亚内战期间，叙利亚阿拉伯军队在大马士革郊区针对反叛武装发动的一次军事行动。行动目标是从由沙姆解放组织（HTS）领导的反叛武装手中夺取大马士革郊区的卡本和巴尔宰。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Latvia on 29 May 2019.

zh.s: 拉脱维亚于2019年5月29日举行间接总统选举。

en.s: The 2019 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2018–19 UEFA Europa League, the 48th season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 10th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. It was played at the Olympic Stadium in Baku, Azerbaijan, on 29 May 2019.

zh.s: 2019年欧足联欧洲联赛决赛是2018—19赛季欧足联欧洲联赛的决赛。这是欧洲第二级别俱乐部足球赛事的第48个赛季，也是赛事从欧洲联盟杯更名为欧洲联赛后的第10个赛季。比赛于2019年5月29日在阿塞拜疆巴库奥林匹克体育场举行。

en.s: The 2020 Austrian Cup final was played on 29 May 2020 between FC Red Bull Salzburg and SC Austria Lustenau at Wörthersee Stadion, Klagenfurt, a neutral ground. The final was the culmination of the 2019–20 Austrian Cup, the 89th season of the Austrian Cup.

zh.s: 2020年奥地利杯决赛于2020年5月29日举行，由萨尔茨堡红牛和奥地利卢斯特瑙交锋，比赛场地是克拉根福的沃尔特湖体育场，这是一处中立场地。该决赛为2019—20赛季奥地利杯画上句号；这是该项赛事第89个赛季。

en.s: On 29 May 2021, a Cessna 501 Citation I/SP crashed into the Percy Priest Lake in Tennessee, United States shortly after takeoff from Smyrna Airport (MQY) in Smyrna, Tennessee. All seven occupants died, including Remnant Fellowship Church founder Gwen Shamblin Lara and her husband, actor Joe Lara, who was piloting the aircraft.

zh.t: 2021年田纳西州塞斯纳奖状飞机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2021年5月29日，一架塞斯纳501奖状I/SP型飞机在美国田纳西州珀西·普里斯特湖坠毁。飞机刚从斯米尔纳机场起飞，事故发生在起飞后不久。机上七人全部遇难，其中包括“余民团契教会”创办人格温·尚布林·拉拉及其丈夫、当时驾驶飞机的演员乔·拉拉。

en.s: On May 29, 2021, jihadists from Boko Haram based along the Nigerien-Nigerian border launched a raid into the city of Diffa, but were repelled by Nigerien soldiers.

zh.s: 2021年5月29日，盘踞在尼日尔与尼日利亚边境一带的博科圣地圣战分子袭击尼日尔迪法市，但被尼日尔士兵击退。

en.s: The 2021 EFL Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 29 May 2021 at Wembley Stadium, London, to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League. The top two teams of the 2020–21 EFL Championship, Norwich City and Watford, gained automatic promotion to the Premier League, while the clubs placed from third to sixth in the table took part in 2021 EFL play-offs.

zh.t: 2021年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2021年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛于2021年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决出从英冠（英格兰第二级别联赛）升入英超的第三支、也是最后一支球队。2020—21赛季英冠排名前两位的诺维奇城和沃特福德自动升入英超，排名第三至第六的球队则参加2021年英格兰足球联赛升级附加赛。

en.s: The 2021 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2020–21 UEFA Champions League, the 66th season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 29th season since it was renamed from the European Cup to the UEFA Champions League. It was played at the Estádio do Dragão in Porto, Portugal on 29 May 2021, between English clubs Manchester City, in their first European Cup final, and 2012 winners Chelsea.

zh.s: 2021年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2020—21赛季欧冠决赛，这是欧足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第66个赛季，也是该赛事从欧洲冠军杯更名为欧洲冠军联赛后的第29个赛季。比赛于2021年5月29日在葡萄牙波尔图巨龙球场举行，英格兰曼城首次闯入欧洲冠军杯决赛，对阵2012年冠军切尔西。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 29 May 2022, with a runoff on 19 June 2022 as no candidate obtained at least 50% in the first round of voting. Iván Duque, who was elected president in 2018, was ineligible to run due to term limits. Gustavo Petro, a senator, former Mayor of Bogotá, and runner-up in the 2018 election, defeated Rodolfo Hernández Suárez, former mayor of Bucaramanga, in the runoff election.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚于2022年5月29日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人获得至少50%的首轮选票，第二轮投票于6月19日举行。2018年当选总统的伊万·杜克因任期限制不能参选。参议员、波哥大前市长、2018年选举亚军古斯塔沃·佩特罗在第二轮中击败布卡拉曼加前市长罗多尔福·埃尔南德斯·苏亚雷斯。

en.s: The 2022 EFL Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 29 May 2022 at Wembley Stadium, London, England, to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.t: 2022年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2022年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛于2022年5月29日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，决出从英冠（英格兰第二级别联赛）升入英超的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2022 Balochistan local government elections were held in 32 districts of Balochistan, Pakistan on 29 May 2022. Independent candidates won the most seats, while 1584 candidates were elected unopposed. According to the results, 98 candidates of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (F), 71 of Balochistan Awami Party, 39 of Pashtunkhwa Milli Awami Party (PKMAP) and 37 of Balochistan National Party have won.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦俾路支省32个地区于2022年5月29日举行地方政府选举。独立候选人赢得最多席位，另有1,584名候选人未经竞争当选。根据选举结果，伊斯兰神学者大会（F）赢得98席，俾路支人民党赢得71席，普什图赫瓦民族人民党（PKMAP）赢得39席，俾路支民族党赢得37席。

en.s: The 2022 Scottish Women's Cup Final was the 49th official final (51st overall) of the Scottish Women's Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match was played on 29 May 2022 at Tynecastle Park, Edinburgh. Celtic and holders Glasgow City were the finalists, on the first occasion they had faced each other in the final.

zh.s: 2022年苏格兰女子杯决赛是苏格兰女子杯第49届正式决赛（总计第51届），该赛事是苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球比赛。比赛于2022年5月29日在爱丁堡泰恩卡斯尔公园球场举行。凯尔特人和卫冕冠军格拉斯哥城进入决赛，这是两队首次在该决赛中相遇。

en.s: The 2022 Thai League Cup final was the final match of the 2021–22 Thai League Cup, the 12th season in the second era of a Thailand's football tournament organised by Football Association of Thailand. It was played at the BG Stadium in Pathum Thani, Thailand on 29 May 2022, between PT Prachuap a big team from Prachuap Khiri Khan located in the Western part and Buriram United a big team from Buriram located in the Northeastern part of Thailand.

zh.s: 2022年泰国联赛杯决赛是2021—22赛季泰国联赛杯的决赛，也是泰国足球协会主办的第二阶段联赛杯赛事第12个赛季。比赛于2022年5月29日在泰国巴吞他尼府BG体育场举行，参赛双方是巴蜀巴特里队和武里南联队；前者来自泰国西部巴蜀府，后者来自东北部武里南府。

en.s: The 2022 Niigata gubernatorial election was held on 29 May 2022. Hideyo Hanazumi was re-elected Governor of Niigata Prefecture.

zh.s: 新潟县于2022年5月29日举行知事选举，花角英世连任新潟县知事。

en.s: The 2022 Russian Cup final was the 30th Russian Cup Final, the final match of the 2021–22 Russian Cup. It was played at Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow, Russia, on 29 May 2022, contested by Spartak Moscow and Dynamo Moscow. It was the first Russian Cup Final at Luzhniki Stadium since 2007 and in Moscow since 2008.

zh.s: 2022年俄罗斯杯决赛是第30届俄罗斯杯决赛，也是2021—22赛季俄罗斯杯的最后一场比赛。比赛于2022年5月29日在俄罗斯莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行，由莫斯科斯巴达克对阵莫斯科迪纳摩。这是该体育场自2007年以来首次承办俄罗斯杯决赛，也是自2008年以来该项决赛首次在莫斯科举行。

en.s: Tara Air Flight 197 was a scheduled domestic flight operated by Tara Air for parent company Yeti Airlines from Pokhara Airport to Jomsom Airport in Nepal. On 29 May 2022, the Twin Otter aircraft carrying 22 people (19 passengers and 3 crew members) departed at 09:55 NPT (04:10 UTC) and lost contact with air traffic controllers about 12 minutes later at 10:07 (04:22).

zh.s: 塔拉航空197号班机是一趟由塔拉航空为其母公司雪人航空运营的尼泊尔国内定期航班，往返博卡拉机场与乔姆索姆机场。2022年5月29日，搭载22人的双水獭飞机（19名乘客和3名机组人员）于尼泊尔时间9时55分（协调世界时4时10分）起飞，约12分钟后，即10时07分（协调世界时4时22分），与空中交通管制失去联系。

en.s: Chapter 153: Super Strong Style 16 Tournament Edition 2023, simply known as the 2023 Super Strong Style 16 was the seventh Super Strong Style 16 professional wrestling tournament produced by Progress Wrestling. It was a three-night event, which took place between May 27 and May 29, 2023. The first night of the event was held at The Dome in London, England, while the second two nights were held at the Electric Ballroom in London, England.

zh.s: Chapter 153：Super Strong Style 16 Tournament Edition 2023，简称2023年Super Strong Style 16，是Progress Wrestling举办的第七届职业摔角Super Strong Style 16锦标赛。这项为期三晚的赛事于2023年5月27日至29日举行。首晚在英格兰伦敦的The Dome举行，后两晚在伦敦的Electric Ballroom举行。

en.s: The 2023 EFL League One play-off final was an association football match which took place on 29 May 2023 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Barnsley and Sheffield Wednesday. It determined the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL League One, the third tier of English football, to the EFL Championship.

zh.t: 2023年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2023年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2023年5月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由巴恩斯利对阵谢菲尔德星期三。比赛决出从英甲（英格兰第三级别联赛）升入英冠的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2023 Alberta general election was held on May 29, 2023. Voters elected the members of the 31st Alberta Legislature. The United Conservative Party under Danielle Smith, the incumbent Premier of Alberta, was re-elected to a second term with a reduced majority. Across the province, 1,763,441 valid votes were cast in the election. The writs of election were issued on May 1, triggering the campaign.

zh.s: 艾伯塔省于2023年5月29日举行大选，选民选出了艾伯塔省议会第31届议员。由时任省长丹妮尔·史密斯领导的联合保守党再次当选执政党，第二次组阁，但多数优势有所缩小。全省共投出1,763,441张有效选票。选举令状于5月1日发布，竞选活动由此开始。

en.s: On 26 May 2023, Kosovo Police forcefully took control of the municipal buildings of four Serb majority regions in Northern Kosovo after a local election was held. Three days later on 29 May 2023, hundreds of Serbian protesters clashed with KFOR peacekeeping troops after rally at city hall in the town of Zvečan in Northern Kosovo.

zh.s: 2023年5月26日，在地方选举后，科索沃警方强行接管了科索沃北部四个塞族占多数地区的市政大楼。三天后的5月29日，数百名塞尔维亚抗议者在北科索沃兹韦钱镇政府大楼集会后，与科索沃驻军（KFOR）维和部队发生冲突。

en.s: The 2024 Gauteng provincial election was held on 29 May 2024, concurrently with the 2024 South African general election, to elect the 73 members of the Gauteng Provincial Legislature. The African National Congress (ANC), led by current Premier Panyaza Lesufi, lost its majority in the Provincial Legislature for the first time since the end of apartheid in 1994.

zh.s: 豪登省于2024年5月29日举行省级选举，与2024年南非大选同期进行，选出豪登省议会73名议员。由现任省长潘亚扎·莱苏菲领导的非洲人国民大会首次在1994年种族隔离制度结束以来失去省议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Western Cape provincial election was held on 29 May 2024, concurrently with the 2024 South African general election, to elect the 42 members of the 7th Western Cape Provincial Parliament.

zh.s: 西开普省于2024年5月29日举行省级选举，与2024年南非大选同期进行，选出第七届西开普省议会42名议员。

en.s: The 2024 KwaZulu-Natal provincial election was held on 29 May 2024, concurrently with the 2024 South African general election, to elect the 80 members of the 7th KwaZulu-Natal Legislature. The new uMkhonto weSizwe Party (MKP) won a plurality with 37 of 80 seats, while the African National Congress (ANC) lost its majority for the first time since 2004, finishing third behind the MKP and Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP).

zh.t: 2024年夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省省级选举
zh.s: 夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省于2024年5月29日举行省级选举，与2024年南非大选同期进行，选出第七届夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省议会80名议员。新成立的民族之矛党（MKP）以80席中的37席成为第一大党。非洲人国民大会首次自2004年以来失去多数席位，排名第三，落后于民族之矛党和因卡塔自由党。

en.s: General elections were held in South Africa on 29 May 2024 to elect a new National Assembly as well as the provincial legislature in each of the nine provinces. This was the seventh general election held under the conditions of universal adult suffrage since the end of the apartheid era in 1994.

zh.s: 南非于2024年5月29日举行大选，选出新一届国民议会以及九个省各自的省议会。这是1994年种族隔离制度结束后、在普遍成人选举权制度下举行的第七次大选。

en.s: The 2024 UEFA Europa Conference League final was the final match of the 2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League, the third season of Europe's tertiary club football tournament organised by UEFA. It was held at the Agia Sophia Stadium in Athens, Greece, on 29 May 2024, between Greek club Olympiacos and Italian club Fiorentina.

zh.t: 2024年欧足联欧洲协会联赛决赛
zh.s: 2024年欧足联欧洲协会联赛决赛是2023—24赛季该赛事的决赛，也是欧足联主办的第三级别欧洲俱乐部足球赛事第三个赛季。比赛于2024年5月29日在希腊雅典圣索菲亚体育场举行，希腊奥林匹亚科斯对阵意大利佛罗伦萨。

en.s: The 2024 Democratic Unionist Party leadership election was held on 29 May 2024 at a meeting of the Party Executive to ratify Gavin Robinson as DUP leader. Robinson had been serving as serving as interim leader since early April when Sir Jeffrey Donaldson resigned from the DUP after being charged with historical sexual offences.

zh.s: 民主统一党于2024年5月29日召开党执行委员会会议，批准加文·罗宾逊出任党魁。杰弗里·唐纳森爵士因被控历史性性犯罪，于4月初辞去党魁职务；此后罗宾逊一直担任临时党魁。

en.s: The 2025 Danish Cup final was played on 29 May 2025 between Copenhagen and Silkeborg at MCH Arena in Herning. The final match was the culmination of the 2024–25 Danish Cup, the 71st season of the Pokalen. Heading into the final, Copenhagen had won the Danish Cup nine times, their most recent title being in 2023. Silkeborg appeared in their fourth final, having previously won the trophy in 2001 and 2024.

zh.s: 2025年5月29日，哥本哈根与锡尔克堡在海宁的MCH竞技场进行丹麦杯决赛，决出2024—25赛季、也是第71届丹麦杯（Pokalen）冠军。哥本哈根此前九次夺得丹麦杯，最近一次是在2023年。锡尔克堡此前四次闯入决赛，曾于2001年和2024年夺冠。
